intro: Parkside is an entry level section of Steiner Ranch, set near the community parks and trails. CleanzATX cleans windows here with the same pure water system and the same published prices we use across the rest of Steiner Ranch.

paragraphs: Parkside is one of the more approachable parts of Steiner Ranch, with homes generally priced around $500K to $650K. The section sits close to parks, so you see kids on bikes, dogs on leashes, and neighbors talking in driveways. It is not gated and falls under the Steiner Ranch Master Association. Homes at this price tend to be mid sized, with a few large windows in the front, a sliding door at the back, and plenty of smaller windows in bedrooms.
It is a family section, and the maintenance that goes with that is usually done on weekends, if at all.

Parks mean trees, grass and sprinklers, and all three leave a mark on glass. Pollen drifts in from cedar and live oak in winter and spring. Lawn irrigation on both sides leaves hard water spots on the lower windows, and those can etch if left. Kids and pets add fingerprints and nose prints, and screens in family homes pick up dust and pet hair. Spider webs collect in window corners near mature trees. A regular pure water clean takes care of most of this, and tracks and screens at $5 each finish the job.
Because the glass is easy to reach, it is a good section for a repeat schedule.

Access is easy here, with no gate and ordinary driveways. We bring our own water, a dual RO, four stage system with a DI resin tank, so glass dries with no spots. For two story homes, the poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which keeps ladders off your house. Interior windows get hand squeegeed, with drop cloths down. If you are choosing between plans, many families here take Twice a Year at 10% off, or Triannual at 15% off, which adds free screen cleaning once a year. We usually route Parkside together with River Heights and other nearby sections, within about two weeks.
A typical visit depends on size. A 2,000 sq ft Parkside house comes to about $200 for exterior windows and takes around two hours.

faq.q: How much does a smaller home cost?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft, and the minimum job is $200. A 2,000 sq ft home works out to about $200. Adding the inside brings Parkside homes to $15 per window.

faq.q: Can you clean around kids and pets?
faq.a: Yes. We ask that gates are unlocked and pets are inside, and we keep the work area tidy. Interior visits use drop cloths, and we are careful with furniture near windows.

faq.q: Do you handle the white spots from lawn sprinklers?
faq.a: Yes. Light spots come off with pure water. Stubborn ones get hard water spot removal at $10 per pane, and we tell you ahead if any glass looks etched.

faq.q: How often should windows be cleaned here?
faq.a: Most families choose two or three visits a year. Triannual is 15% off and includes free yearly screen cleaning, hard water removal on up to 5 windows each visit, and the 7 day rain guarantee.

faq.q: What if rain hits after the visit?
faq.a: The 7 day rain guarantee comes with Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans. On any job, text us a photo within 7 days and we return free when we are in the area.
